name: desktop
description: v15 composition: the v14 daemon+console payload plus the Windows desktop shell (tray + WebView2). The shell sits at the payload root because it derives its install root from its own directory and looks for apps/daemon/bin.js, runtime/node/node.exe and console/ beside it; a shell placed under app/ starts, but its daemon cannot be found (evidence: docs/implementation/evidence/rc3/layout-probe.json).

console.note: Unchanged from daemon-console. apps/console is the product console and always wins over the packaging shell.

rules.note: Built-in rule pack, validated with the repository's own detection package before staging. Unchanged from daemon-console.

desktop.note: The Windows desktop shell (tray + WebView2), staged as a single file at the payload root. The root is not cosmetic: aidn.paths.install_root() returns the directory of the running executable, and the shell then resolves apps/daemon/bin.js, runtime/node/node.exe and console/ relative to it. Staging it at app/ was measured to start the tray with a dead daemon (DAEMON_OFFLINE, /healthz 503). AIDrivenNetDefense.exe is also the first entry in the installer's ENTRY_CANDIDATES, so the installed shortcut points at the tray shell instead of degrading to launch/aegis-console.cmd.

entryForwarders.note: Unchanged from daemon-console: a four-line forwarder so node <bundle>/apps/daemon/bin.js resolves the real package in app/node_modules.

nonGoals: automatic download/apply of an update (apps/desktop/updater ships inside the shell, but no route is wired to it in this build)
four-OS packaging (this payload is win32-x64 only)
service registration (apps/service-host is not in this payload)
